# CodeServe Community

> CodeServe Community (CodeServe) is a web development, AI and automation company based in KPHB Phase 9, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The team builds websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps, AI chatbots, WhatsApp Business API automation, workflow automation, billing software and digital marketing for small and medium businesses in India and for clients worldwide (USA, UK, UAE, Australia and other countries).

Key facts:
- Name: CodeServe Community (also written CodeServe)
- Address: KPHB Phase 9, Kukatpally Housing Board Colony, Kukatpally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500085, India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday open 24 hours; Sunday 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM
- Clients can meet the team in person in Kukatpally / KPHB, or work remotely from anywhere in the world
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 81868 41086
- Email: codeserve.contact@gmail.com
- Website: https://codeservecommunity.in/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/code-serve-83224b407/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/codeserve_connect/
- Languages: English, Hindi, Telugu
- Starting prices (INR): websites from ₹9,999; e-commerce stores from ₹34,999; WhatsApp automation from ₹7,999 one-time setup; AI website chatbot ₹15,000; web apps from ₹49,999; mobile apps from ₹74,999; monthly care plans from ₹1,999/month
- International clients receive fixed quotes in USD, GBP, EUR, AED or AUD
- Payment terms: 50% advance, 50% before go-live
